$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P2 round-3 task `p2r3/deps-contract`. The list is EMPTY, and that is the correct state: this lane changes one inter-stage schema and installs nothing new. Every invariant the content pipeline owns is a property of a produced pack, and this lane produces no pack. The work it does own has no invariant id and is listed under `heldWithoutAnInvariantId`.
heldWithoutAnInvariantId: The `candidate` record now carries `analysis`, required and nullable, in G1's shape: {analyser, tokens, lemmas, display_tokens}. It is founder ruling B16 option 2 — carry G1's analysis across the G5 -> G7 boundary — and it exists because G7 resolved a gap by the SURFACE at the gap index ('needed 3 distractors for tardes (POS , band unbanded)'; `tardes` is a surface, `tarde` is the lemma). The alternative was a second analyser pass inside G7, which would make G7 depend on the `nlp` group as well as `align`.

`Token` and `Adapter` are now ONE object each, shared by `analysed_sentence` and `candidate.analysis`, rather than two copies that agree today. The expand lane reads one function over a corpus row and an authored row, so a field added to one copy and not the other is a crash in the lane that did nothing wrong. `test_the_analysis_is_the_g1_shape_and_cannot_drift_from_it` asserts object equality, not field names. Factoring them out is byte-identical to the previous schema set: the digest was still 3e2f6a68… after the refactor and changed only when `analysis` was added.

Closedness is now asserted over the WHOLE schema tree, not only the nine top-level records. `test_every_record_is_closed` never read `analysed_sentence.adapter`, `exercise.item_tags` or anything nested, so an open sub-object was the one hole the 'additionalProperties: false' property did not cover. The walk is counted (>= 14 objects) so it cannot pass by walking nothing, and `test_the_open_payload_is_the_only_object_the_contract_leaves_open` pins `pack_row.payload` as the single deliberate exemption so a second one cannot appear as 'the existing pattern'.

`validate_record` now picks its error with `jsonschema.exceptions.best_match` instead of `validate()`. A nullable sub-object is a `oneOf`, and the plain report for one is 'analysis: {the whole object, inlined} is not valid under any of the given schemas' — no field named, one token bundle per word printed, for a stage streaming hundreds of rows. With best_match the same record reports `analysis/tokens/0: 'start' is a required property`. Pinned by `test_a_token_missing_its_offsets_is_refused_and_the_message_names_the_token`, which also asserts the combinator message is NOT what comes out.

`analysis: null` is legal and `analysis` is still required: nullable is not optional. A candidate rejected on `stale_ledger` is rejected before the analyser is reached, and those rows are written because the reject rate is the number that says the ledger window is too tight. 'Non-null exactly when G7 will read it' is not expressible as a schema keyword, so the rule is a coded one in the expand lane and it must fail BY NAME on a null analysis for a row it is asked to expand.

handoff.$dischargedAt: Merge d73d295 (main, 2026-09-12). All four edits below are APPLIED and the list is kept as the record of what the schema change cost, not as outstanding work. Measured on main after the merge: `uv run pytest` 837 collected (835 + the two new tests named below), 0 failures, exit 0 over three runs — default order, `-p no:randomly`, and `tests/test_g6_validate_language.py` alone. `writeTheRealAnalysis` landed as described: `_lemmas` became `_analyse` and returns the whole record, `_axis` returns `(axis, analysis)` so the two `stale_ledger` short-circuits above the adapter call are the only rows carrying null, and `_candidate_analysis` projects G1's record onto the four closed fields. Two tests were added that the handoff did not ask for, because 'pytest is green' does not distinguish a real analysis from a schema-shaped filler: `test_an_emitted_candidate_carries_the_analysis_g7_will_read` re-derives the analysis from a second independent call to the registered adapter and asserts equality field by field (it fails if `display_tokens` is built from `tokens` instead of the lexical subset — checked by mutation, not assumed), and `test_a_stale_row_carries_a_null_analysis_because_the_analyser_never_ran` pins the nullable case.
handoff.$comment: This branch adds a REQUIRED key to `candidate`, so every existing writer of that record is now invalid. That is the contract mechanism working (a schema edit with a failing test attached), not a defect, but it means 60 coursekit tests are red on this branch and every lane that merges it inherits them. The fix is mechanical and the work is owned elsewhere. Measured: with the four edits below applied, `uv run pytest` is 835 collected, exit 0 — so nothing in this change is semantic.

writeTheRealAnalysis.what: the record dict in `gapfill()` (around the `"provenance": AUTHORED_PROVENANCE,` line) must carry `analysis`. G5 already runs the pinned adapter over exactly this text in `_lemmas()`; that call returns the whole analysis dict and the function currently throws away everything but `lemmas` and `len(display_tokens)`. Return the analysis and put {analyser, tokens, lemmas, display_tokens} on the row. A row rejected before the analyser runs (`stale_ledger`) carries null.
